content: Warra-miḏangarrina-yung marri warra-miḏaṉngina-yung.

Nguynju-waj, nugurru aadanu warra-miḏangarrina-yung, nambaa-yandhurrbangana nugurri-nyinyung warra-miḏaṉnginaaj. Ari warraawurru-yung waari ambirri-yandhurrbang na-God-jinyung ana-lhaawu. Yagu nugurru-maynji numburru-waṉbina yij-mamaaḻang-galawaj, ari amburru-jambarrgina wugurru. Wiiya nugurru waari nurru-yambi ana-lhaawu,
yagu wugurru nambambi-nayii, nugurru numburraaṉbina-yinyung maaḻamburrg-waj, marri numbunaa-gurrij-ngu-burraa na-God. Wudani-yung-gala nga, ari wugurru amburru-jambarrgina nigawi-wuy.

Nugurru nurru-marrbuy? Nugurru warra-maṉaṉung, yagi numburru-milagaga-mi arabarabalu-waj. Yagi nirrimaarraaynbijgi mana-mung, yagi nurru-yabi manubami-yung mana-yaaḻi-alaaladi-yinyung mana-yaaḻi, marri runggal gold marri aniijiijung.

Yagu nugurri-nyinyung ana-mamanunggu, yaani anggiijamana, a-lhirribala-yii. Nugurru numburru-yaal-murramurra marri numburru-lhamaamura nugurru. Yaani-yung waari wu-jadugi, marri niga na-God niwu-ngaynbandii-windiyung.

Anaani-yinyung wiijamaa, anubani-yunggaj, warruburru-yung warra-maṉaṉung wurru-jambarrgini-yinyung na-God, wugurru wunu-garrindharrmangi niga, marri wurru-mamanunggu, anaani wiijamaa, wugurru warra-yandhurrbangaa wugurri-nyinyung warra-miḏaṉngina-yung.

Nugurru nurru-marrbuy ngiga ngarra-Sarah. Ngiga ngunu-yandhurrbangaa na-Abraham, ngigawi-yinyung naaṉngina-yung, marri ngunu-mayaa niga runggal-yung. Nugurru aadanu numburru-yamana ngigawi-yii, numburru-waṉbina maaḻamburrg-waj marri yagi nurru-ḏirrngawi, marri nugurru numburru-burraa warra-mijburrayung ngarra-Sarah-yinyung.

Nugurru aadanu warra-miḏaṉngina-yung, numburru-burraa maaḻamburrg-galawaj nugurri-nyinyung-duj warra-miḏangarrinaaj. Numburru-dhi-maṉdhina wugurri-wuy, wugurru yamba wurru-bilwilwiluj, marri niga na-God wani-walgaṉmaa wugurri-wuy, nguynju nugurri-yii. Nguynju yadhu yagi wu-muḏaḏbi nugurri-nyinyung ana-lhaawu, numburru-yambina-yinyung na-God-guy.

Yaani aḏaba wu-jadugina ngana-magana-yinyung. Nugurru warraarrawindi-lhangu, numburru-lhamaamura numburru-burraa. Marri numburru-man.galagaynjina nugurraajbaj, marri numburraa-ḏamarr-ngu-burrangijgaynjina, marri numburru-yaal-murramurra aadanu.

Warraaynbaj-maynji ambu-waṉbina anaaladi nugurri-wuy, yagi narraagagijgi. Wugurru-maynji nambambiiladi-yamawana nugurri-wuy, yagi nugurru narraaladi-yamawi wugurru. Yagi. Nugurru numbunu-yambina na-God-guy, nguynju yadhu ambaniigajij-majgana wugurru. Niga yamba na-God, nanii-gaḏangi nugurru, nguynju yadhu niga nambaniigajij-majgana nugurru.
Waarrarrini-yinyung anaani ana-lhaawu wu-yamana ana-mamanunggu ana-wubiba-rruj,

content.text: Numburru-muḏaḏbang nurru-waṉbina-yinyung anaaladi marri numburru-waṉbina maaḻamburrg-galawaj,
Yagu wugurraayung wurru-waṉbina-yinyung anaaladi, niga rulbu waniiyii wugurri-wuy.”

content: Dani-yung wu-yamana ana-wubiba.
Nugurru aadanu ngirri-magana ngaya. Nugurru-maynji numburru-ngaynbandii numburru-waṉbina-wugij mamanunggu-waj, yuga warraaynbaj nambambi-warragayijgana? Yagi nambi-warragayijgi!

Yagu ari warraaynbaj nambambi-warragayijgana, nugurru yamba numburru-waṉbina maaḻamburrg-waj. Yagu wiiya aadanu, (Isaiah 8:12) “Yagi nurru-ḏirrngawi, niga yamba na-God nambaniigajij-majgana nugurru. Yagi nurru-ramarr-ruwi-ruwi nugurru.”

Nguynju-waj, numbunaa-gurrij-ngu-burraa na-Christ na-Runggal-yung nugurri-rruj anaandhiri. Marri warruburru-yung-maynji nambambi-yandhawiwana, a-yangi-yadhu nugurru nurru-wurrij-dhaḻagina, nugurru numburru-wuguuguni-wugij nambarra-yambalmana wugurri-wuy.

Nambarra-magana lhamaamura-waj marri yaynjaalul-mirri. Marri numburru-lhaal-maaḻang-bindiyung nugurru. Marri numburru-waṉbina-wugij maaḻamburrg-galawaj, nugurru yamba nuunaa-ngu-jambarrgina niga na-Christ. Wugurraayung warra-mulung-aynbaj ari nambambiiladi-yamawana nugurru, yagu yamba nugurru numburru-waṉbina ana-maaḻamburrg, yagu wurrugu, amburraambulang warruburru-yung.

Nugurru yuga nurru-marrbuy? Anubani-yung-maynji na-God ani-wijangayii, nugurru ari numburraarragayii, nugurru yamba numburru-waṉbina ana-maaḻamburrg. Anaani anggiij-maṉdhina. Yagu nugurru-maynji numburru-waṉbina anaaladi, marri wugurru nambambii-gaagijgina, anaani waari wiij-maṉdhi.

Nugurru yuga nurru-marrbuy? Niga na-Christ ni-ngawiiyn anaalaaladi yungguyung. Niga waari ani-waṉbini anaaladi, yagu niga ngarranii-ngawiiyn ngagurraa yungguyung, anaani ngurru-waṉbina-yinyung anaaladi. Niga nani-yarrijgini nugurru na-God-guy. Nigawi-yinyung ana-wubulu wunu-wini-yinyung, yagu nigawi-nyinyung na-ni-mawurr-yung, ni-wiri-wugij.
Marri niga na-ni-mawurr-yung ni-yanggi marri wani-yambini ana-mawurr warra-wurru-wurruj-guy, wurru-ngawini-yinyung, marri wurru-dhidini wugurru.

Anubani-yunggaj wugurru wurru-lhaabini, waari amburru-jambarrgini na-God-guy, anubani-yung-gaj anubani-yung na-Noah. Na-God wani-rangarrangi wugurri-wuy, wurrugu na-Noah nima-raani mana-barrawu. Wurraadharra warra-wurru-wurruj 8 wurru-wiri-mayn anaa-gugu-wala.

Wudanila-yung-galawaj, wu-yamana nguynju a-malnguj-jii, anaani wiijamana, ngagurru ngurraambara-ngambina, marri niga na-God ngarrani-wiri-gana ngagurru. Nugurru yuga nurru-marrbuy? Anubani-yumbaa nugurru nurraambara-ngambini, nugurru waari-wugij anggu-yarrbini ana-ngun.gu. Nugurru nuunu-lhalamayaa na-God-guy, marri nurru-lhaal-maaḻang aadanu. Marri niga nani-wiri-gayn, niga yamba na-Jesus Christ ni-ḻaḻagiiyn anubanila-wala ana-ngawij.
Aḏaba na-Jesus ni-yanggi buguni anaarrwiyaj, marri aḏaba ni-burraa na-God-duj a-walawalama-rruj. Marri niga ni-buunggawa-mana ana-angel marri anaarrawindi-lhangu waṉagana-yinyung ana-lhuḏ.
